offers_products.reason: Sells propane fuel, cylinders and tanks to homes and businesses; also fuel oil and natural gas/electricity marketing.

offers_services.reason: Delivery, tank refill, installation, heating system service and repair technicians alongside fuel sales; fuel is the larger part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Residential customers heating homes with propane are the largest buyer group.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Commercial and industrial customers: agriculture, forklifts, restaurants, fleets, construction buy propane.

recurring_revenue.reason: Customers repeatedly refill propane tanks on delivery schedules; ongoing fuel purchases dominate revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Home heating and cooking propane is a necessity; demand depends more on weather than the economy.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sale is a routine propane tank fill, small and frequent.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for propane fuel, delivered with a truck fleet and storage assets, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households and small commercial users such as restaurants, farms and food trucks.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs delivery truck fleet, storage terminals, tanks, cylinders and many branch locations across 42 states.

notes: Business is mainly propane; fuel oil, natural gas and electricity marketing and renewables are smaller.
